rca of the issue: Potential edge-case RCA: uploads._get_object currently awaits stream.close() only when asyncio.iscoroutine(close_result) is true. Some libraries return generic awaitables (implementing __await__) that are not coroutine objects, so cleanup may not execute. Mitigation recommendation: use inspect.isawaitable(close_result) for robust await detection.
